dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white spots forming a distinct 'beaded' horizontal line across the median coverts; broader white tipping visible on the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp white margins on the edges of the folded tertials and secondaries, creating high-contrast boundaries against dark gray-blue feather centers.

other_distinctive_markers: The median covert wing bar exhibits a unique beaded appearance consisting of discrete circular white spots rather than a continuous band.
